title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Zanzibari Sauce
description: A flavorful Chinese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared snapper topped with a zesty zanzibari sauce. This recipe serves 2 and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the snapper fillets dry with a paper towel.
Add the buttery to the skillet and melt.
Sear the snapper fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the snapper cooks, mix the zanzibari, red, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Serve the snapper fillets topped with the zanzibari sauce.
Garnish with additional zanzibari, if desired.
